arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import re, zipfile, shutil

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_tmp.xlsx'

z = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
sheet = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode()
styles = z.read('xl/styles.xml').decode()

rows = [
    (2, 150, 25, 15),
    (3, 200, 25, 15),
    (4, 75, 45, 28),
    (5, 120, 45, 28),
    (6, 50, 99, 55),
    (7, 85, 99, 55),
    (8, 30, 199, 50),
    (9, 45, 199, 50),
]

def margin(units, price, cost):
    revenue = units * price
    profit = revenue - units * cost
    return profit / revenue

total_rev = sum(u * p for u, p, c in rows)
total_profit = sum(u * (p - c) for u, p, c in rows)
total_margin = total_profit / total_rev

sheet = sheet.replace('dimension ref="A1:G10"', 'dimension ref="A1:H10"')
sheet = sheet.replace('</cols>', '<col width="14" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>', 1)

sheet = re.sub(r'(<row r="1">.*?)</row>',
    r'\1<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c></row>',
    sheet, count=1, flags=re.DOTALL)

for r, units, price, cost in rows:
    cell = '<c r="H%d" s="3"><f>G%d/E%d</f><v>%.10g</v></c></row>' % (r, r, r, margin(units, price, cost))
    sheet = re.sub(r'(<row r="%d">.*?)</row>' % r,
        lambda m, c=cell: m.group(1) + c,
        sheet, count=1, flags=re.DOTALL)

total_cell = '<c r="H10" s="3"><f>G10/E10</f><v>%.10g</v></c></row>' % total_margin
sheet = re.sub(r'(<row r="10">.*?)</row>',
    lambda m, c=total_cell: m.group(1) + c,
    sheet, count=1, flags=re.DOTALL)

styles = styles.replace('<numFmts count="0"/>',
    '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>')
styles = styles.replace('<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="4">')
styles = styles.replace('</cellXfs>',
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0" applyNumberFormat="1"/></cellXfs>')

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
zout = zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for item in zin.infolist():
    data = zin.read(item.filename)
    if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
        data = sheet.encode()
    elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
        data = styles.encode()
    zout.writestr(item, data)
zout.close()
zin.close()
shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print('Done. Total margin:', total_margin)
EOF
